plain: A guest named Charles, on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, talks about scientist Ning Li's experiments with spinning superconductors, special materials that carry electricity without resistance when very cold, which she claimed could affect gravity. He says that someone, he thinks NASA, the US space agency, tried to repeat her work and did not see the effect.
